segments.flavor: the station ID, at fire-drill volume
segments.text: Puck: [cheerful] PEAK FM! The station that treats a plain Tuesday like a fire drill! Music!

segments.flavor: the station ID, with Bella overruled
segments.text:
Puck: Bella says I have had enough coffee for one entire morning.
Puck: Bella does not run this station. PEAK FM! Music, go!

segments.flavor: the station ID, two speeds only
segments.text:
Puck: Peak FM has two speeds. Loud, and slightly louder than loud.
Puck: HAHA! Nobody has found a third speed. Back to the songs!

segments.flavor: the station ID, the excited kettle
segments.text: Puck: [shouting] PEAK FM! Somewhere a kettle just boiled from pure excitement! Here comes more music!

segments.flavor: a ridiculous on-air challenge for the listener with instant fake results
segments.text:
Puck: Challenge of the hour: say one kind thing to a houseplant, out loud, with feeling.
Puck: Results already in. The plant grew, and the man cried. Song. Now. Go.

segments.flavor: a ridiculous on-air challenge for the listener with instant fake results
segments.text:
Puck: New challenge: climb one single flight of stairs, and do not sigh once at the top. Easy.
Puck: [laugh] Results are in. The entire building failed on the first step. Roll the music before I invent another one.

segments.flavor: a ridiculous on-air challenge for the listener with instant fake results
segments.text:
Puck: Today's challenge: hold an elevator door open and smile for the entire ride.
Bella: Instant results are in. Four people got on. Not one pressed a button.
Puck: NO WAY. They rode around as a group? With no destination at all?
Bella: Floor two. Then floor two again. They are friends now.
Puck: That is beautiful and I take full credit. More music, and less of me.

segments.flavor: a ridiculous on-air challenge for the listener with instant fake results
segments.text:
Puck: Big challenge: carry every grocery bag inside in one single heroic trip.
Bella: The results came back instantly, and they are not good.
Puck: Tell me. I can take it. I invented this challenge myself.
Bella: Eleven bags. One man. Two hands. The eggs did not survive.
Puck: The eggs knew the risk! They signed up for this!
Bella: They signed nothing. Eggs cannot sign anything.
Puck: Then the potatoes rolled into the street and I caught four!
Bella: Four out of nine. Here is a song to calm the room.

segments.flavor: a ridiculous on-air challenge for the listener with instant fake results
segments.text:
Puck: New challenge. One full hour without saying the word basically. Starting now.
Bella: You said it twice while explaining the rules.
Puck: That does not count! Rules happen outside the game!
Bella: The scoreboard disagrees. The record in this building is nine seconds.
Puck: NINE SECONDS? Give me a name. I want to beat an actual name.
Bella: It was a man in accounting, and he was asleep at the time.
Puck: So the record belongs to an unconscious man. Perfect. I accept.
Bella: You have lost it twice since the rules ended.
Puck: Then I am going for third place and a small trophy. One more song before anything else happens.

segments.flavor: Puck's hot take of the hour; Bella ends it with one line; big reactions written as words
segments.text:
Puck: Hot take of the hour: soup is a drink and the spoon is stalling.
Bella: That is a lot of confidence from a man holding a fork. Hit the music.

segments.flavor: Puck's hot take of the hour; Bella ends it with one line; big reactions written as words
segments.text:
Puck: Hot take. The snooze button is cardio. A person wakes up nine times. Nine!
Bella: That is not how cardio works, or mornings, or numbers.
Puck: Nine wake ups! A full training camp before breakfast!
Bella: He is going to put that on a shirt. Next song, please, quickly.

segments.flavor: Puck's hot take of the hour; Bella ends it with one line; big reactions written as words
segments.text:
Puck: Hot take: nobody owns an umbrella. Everyone is borrowing one from the future.
Bella: Oh. OH. Okay, that one almost landed.
Puck: ALMOST? Every umbrella is a rental with no paperwork and no return date!
Bella: Then why is mine in your bag, with my name on the handle?
Puck: Borrowing. From the future. Take it away, music.

segments.flavor: Puck's hot take of the hour; Bella ends it with one line; big reactions written as words
segments.text:
Puck: Hot take of the hour. An office chair has wheels, so an office chair is a vehicle.
Bella: It is furniture. It is very clearly furniture.
Puck: Four wheels, a seat, and a speed. That is a car with commitment issues.
Bella: There is no speed. It rolls when somebody pushes it.
Puck: That is a speed! That is the entire definition of a speed!
Bella: He wants a licence plate for a chair. Straight into the next one.

segments.flavor: Puck's hot take of the hour; Bella ends it with one line; big reactions written as words
segments.text:
Puck: Hot take, and I will defend it all hour. The second slice of toast is a disappointment.
Bella: A disappointment. Toast.
Puck: The first slice gets the good butter, the attention, the respect. The second gets leftovers.
Bella: The second slice is identical. Same bread, same bag.
Puck: Same bag, completely different destiny! The first slice is the headline act!
Bella: Ohhh he is building a ranking. I can hear it starting.
Puck: I am not ranking. I am ordering toast.
Bella: Those are the same thing.
Puck: Slice one, magnificent. Slice two, acceptable. Slice three, a cry for help.
Bella: Nobody has ever made a third slice.
Puck: I have. Twice, before the first song. HAHA! Music. I have said enough.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for the Enthusiasm Clock
segments.text:
Puck: The Enthusiasm Clock does not beep. The Enthusiasm Clock gives compliments until somebody stands up.
Bella: It knows four compliments. It says them forever, in the dark.
Puck: A great morning starts with being told about it, loudly, at full volume.
Bella: Not for shared walls, light sleepers, or anybody with a nervous disposition.
Puck: The Enthusiasm Clock. Wake up adored. Play something loud.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for the Never Empty Mug
segments.text:
Puck: Introducing the Never Empty Mug, the only mug that refuses to reach the bottom.
Bella: It is a small mug inside a bigger mug. That is the entire invention.
Puck: Every sip is met by another sip. The coffee simply continues.
Bella: Holds forty millilitres. Weighs two kilograms. Cannot be washed, ever.
Puck: The Never Empty Mug. Endless, technically. Songs. Many of them. Starting now.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for the Big Entrance Doorbell
segments.text:
Puck: The Big Entrance Doorbell replaces that sad little ding with a full chorus.
Bella: Forty seconds of chorus. Every time. Even for a delivery.
Puck: A guest arrives, the key change lands, and the hallway becomes an event.
Bella: Neighbours may object. Courts have agreed with the neighbours.
Puck: The Big Entrance Doorbell. Arrive like somebody. Cue a song immediately.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for Hype Socks
segments.text:
Puck: Hype Socks cheer for a person every single time that person stands up.
Bella: They cheer when anyone stands. Including at funerals.
Puck: Standing is an achievement! Hype Socks understand what the room refuses to say!
Bella: Volume cannot be lowered. The cheering cannot be switched off.
Puck: Hype Socks. Applause, from the ankles. Rolling into the next track.

segments.flavor: Guess That Sound
segments.text:
Puck: It is time for Guess That Sound! I make the sound, Bella names the sound.
Bella: I have never once been right.
Puck: Ready? Here it comes. Nnnnyeeer. Nyer. Clunk.
Bella: A lorry reversing into a drum kit.
Puck: It was a fridge door! A heavy fridge door!
Bella: Nothing about that was a fridge.
Puck: It was the big fridge downstairs! We are so close! Here comes a chorus to fix that.

segments.flavor: Word Of The Hour
segments.text:
Puck: Word Of The Hour! The word is spatula, and I will use it constantly.
Bella: You used it wrong before the segment even started.
Puck: I said the traffic was spatula. That is a bold and modern usage.
Bella: That is not a usage. That is a man losing a word.
Puck: Spatula! Say it once. Feel taller. Feel flatter, somehow.
Bella: The word means the thing that flips an egg. Nothing else.
Puck: Not any more! Word Of The Hour, now with extra meanings! Music while I recover.

segments.flavor: Sky patches in a caller moment that goes wrong fast; everyone talks over each other with dashes
segments.text:
Puck: The caller line rang. I answered with my very best radio voice. Nobody there.
Puck: Just a hairdryer, running, for eleven seconds. I am pressing the button. Here is a song.

segments.flavor: Sky patches in a caller moment that goes wrong fast; everyone talks over each other with dashes
segments.text:
Puck: Line one! Sky, where in the world are we finding you?
Sky: In a car wash! I thought I had time before the —
Puck: Before the what? SKY? Before the WHAT?
Sky: [breathless] The water! It is the water! I have to go!
Bella: And that is our caller line. The songs take over now.

segments.flavor: Sky patches in a caller moment that goes wrong fast; everyone talks over each other with dashes
segments.text:
Puck: Caller line! Sky is somewhere, and it sounds cold. Sky?
Sky: I am lost in a supermarket. Every aisle looks the same.
Puck: Follow the music! Every shop plays music! Walk toward it!
Sky: That is a freezer humming. I followed a freezer for — oh no.
Bella: She dropped the phone into the frozen peas.
Puck: SKY! The peas cannot help you! Back into the songs where it is safer.

segments.flavor: Sky patches in a caller moment that goes wrong fast; everyone talks over each other with dashes
segments.text:
Puck: The caller line is live! Sky, welcome to Peak FM!
Sky: Finally. I have been holding for the gardening programme for forty minutes.
Puck: The what? Sky, this is a morning show.
Bella: We have one fern. It is plastic, and it is thriving.
Sky: Then who do I ask about my tomatoes?
Puck: I will take it! Tomatoes want sun, water, and no interference!
Bella: He has never grown a single thing in his life.
Sky: Still better than the gardening programme. Bye!
Puck: SHE LIKED IT! Song next, and it is a good one.

segments.flavor: Sky patches in a caller moment that goes wrong fast; everyone talks over each other with dashes
segments.text:
Puck: Caller line! Sky, it sounds like you are moving at speed.
Sky: I am on a bus and it will not stop.
Puck: What do you mean it will not stop? Press the button!
Bella: She is being taken somewhere against her will by public transport.
Puck: This is a hostage situation with a timetable! Sky, what can you see?
Sky: A roundabout. Then the same roundabout. I think we are going around twice.
Bella: Oh. OH. That is not a route. That is a loop.
Puck: SKY! Get off at the studio! We will wave!
Sky: You are on the wrong side of the — here it goes again!
Bella: And she is gone. Around, and around. Onward, to a song.

segments.flavor: back-announce {STREAM} like it just won an award; Puck overcommits
segments.text:
Puck: That run of songs just went undefeated. Not one weak track in it.
Puck: I would put the whole thing in a museum. Here comes the next champion.

segments.flavor: back-announce {STREAM} like it just won an award; Puck overcommits
segments.text:
Puck: I just gave that last song a full standing ovation, alone, in a completely empty studio. Both hands.
Puck: Nobody else clapped, so I clapped twice as hard for the two of us. More music, same volume.

segments.flavor: back-announce {STREAM} like it just won an award; Puck overcommits
segments.text:
Puck: That set of songs walked up, accepted the award, and thanked its parents.
Bella: A playlist does not have parents.
Puck: Everything has parents, Bella! Somewhere out there is an older, slower song!
Bella: [sigh] He is going to write a speech for a playlist.
Puck: I have already written it. It opens with gratitude. Cue the music, and cue it fast.

segments.flavor: back-announce {STREAM} like it just won an award; Puck overcommits
segments.text:
Puck: I built a display case for that last hour of music. Glass. Velvet. The works.
Bella: It is a shoebox. He cut the window with a butter knife.
Puck: It is a CASE! It has a window! A window makes it a case!
Bella: There is a shoe in it.
Puck: The shoe is a placeholder! The real trophy is on its way!
Bella: There is no trophy. There has never been a trophy. Big song coming. Hold on.

segments.flavor: back-announce {STREAM} like it just won an award; Puck overcommits
segments.text:
Puck: That last run of music deserves a speech, so I have written one.
Bella: How long is it?
Puck: Four minutes. Five with the pauses. Six if the room reacts well.
Bella: The room is two people, and one of them is timing you.
Puck: Fine. The short version. Songs, thank you for carrying this whole hour.
Bella: That was good. Stop there.
Puck: I am not finished. There is a middle section with a list.
Bella: Of course there is.
Puck: Thank you to the drums, the chorus, the quiet bit in the middle —
Bella: Twenty seconds.
Puck: And thank you to whoever decided a song should have a chorus at all!
Bella: Time. Sit down. The songs continue. So does he.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for Peak Hot Sauce
segments.text:
Puck: Peak Hot Sauce arrives in three strengths: brave, unwise, and full apology.
Bella: The apology is in the box. It is already written out.
Puck: One drop wakes a sandwich. Two drops wake the neighbours.
Bella: Do not apply to skin, to bread, or to anything anyone intends to eat.
Puck: Peak Hot Sauce. Regret, bottled. Back to the playlist.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for the Polite Horn
segments.text:
Puck: The Polite Horn replaces that angry blast with a warm, sincere thank you.
Bella: It says thank you at one hundred decibels.
Puck: Courtesy should be heard from three streets away. That is simply good manners.
Bella: Not legal in most places. Possibly not legal anywhere at all.
Puck: The Polite Horn. Rude volume, lovely message. A song now. A big one.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for Second Breakfast In A Can
segments.text:
Puck: Second Breakfast In A Can holds an entire second breakfast, in liquid form.
Bella: It is beige. It is warm. It arrives warm on purpose.
Puck: Eggs, beans, and optimism, all shaken into one confident tin.
Bella: One can per year. Do not open near soft furnishings.
Puck: Second Breakfast In A Can. Because the first one gave up. Let us hear something with a chorus.

segments.flavor: a fake ad for Peak Paint
segments.text:
Puck: Peak Paint is the only paint bright enough to wake a room before sunrise.
Bella: It comes in one colour. The colour is called Consequences.
Puck: One coat, and that room never feels sleepy again. Ever.
Bella: Cannot be covered. Two coats of white will not hide it.
Puck: Peak Paint. Now the walls are awake too. We go back to the songs.

segments.flavor: Puck Ranks Things
segments.text:
Puck: Puck Ranks Things! This hour I am ranking every chair in this building.
Bella: There are nine chairs.
Puck: Number one, the good chair by the window. That chair knows what it is.
Bella: It is broken. It leans hard to the left.
Puck: It leans with confidence! Number two, the stool nobody ever chooses!
Bella: Because it is a stool. Nobody chooses a stool.
Puck: Last place, that plastic thing in the hallway. It has done nothing for anyone.
Bella: You sat in it all morning. Here is music instead of an apology.

segments.flavor: the forecast for a town that does not exist
segments.text:
Puck: The Peak FM forecast for Mount Awake, a town that exists only here!
Bella: Because we invented it, and it has no residents.
Puck: Sunshine at the summit, mild panic in the valley, sixteen degrees of pure potential.
Bella: Wind?
Puck: Enthusiastic! Coming from every direction at once, which is scientifically impossible!
Bella: Nothing in that forecast is possible.
Puck: Later in Mount Awake, more sun and a small parade!
Bella: There is no parade. There is nobody to parade. That is enough from the studio. Music.

segments.flavor: Two Truths And A Puck
segments.text:
Puck: Two Truths And A Puck! Two of these are true. Bella finds the lie.
Bella: Go.
Puck: One. I slept through an entire thunderstorm. Two. I own eleven identical shirts.
Puck: Three. I have never lost an argument inside this studio.
Bella: The third one. Obviously the third one.
Puck: WRONG! I have never lost an argument. I simply stop having them.
Bella: That is losing. That is the definition of losing.
Puck: Then the lie was the shirts. There are fourteen. I am out of words. Song time.

segments.flavor: the Peak FM Leaderboard
segments.text:
Puck: The Peak FM Leaderboard! The standing record is a paper plane across this studio.
Bella: Current holder, the man who fixes the lights, and he is not here.
Puck: Eleven metres! Eleven! I have attempted it forty times this hour.
Bella: Best attempt, two metres, straight into a window.
Puck: The window moved! I have witnesses!
Bella: You have one witness, and she is telling everybody the truth.
Puck: New rule. Window interference now counts as distance! Now a song, and then more songs.

segments.flavor: One Breath
segments.text:
Puck: One Breath! Bella asks a question, and I answer without breathing once.
Bella: Describe a perfect morning.
Puck: Loud alarm, hot coffee, cold air, a good chorus, a green light, a friendly dog, a —
Bella: Breath.
Puck: I DID NOT BREATHE! That was a pause for dramatic effect!
Bella: It was a gasp. Everybody in this room heard the gasp.
Puck: Judges? Bella is the judge. Bella is also the opponent. This system is broken!
Bella: The system works fine. You lose. The music saves us again. Here it is.

segments.flavor: Name That Snack
segments.text:
Puck: Name That Snack! Bella describes a snack badly. I name it in three guesses.
Bella: Small. Loud. Comes in a bag that is mostly air.
Puck: Crisps! Obviously crisps! One guess, and I am finished!
Bella: Wrong. It was a bag of ice.
Puck: A BAG OF ICE IS NOT A SNACK!
Bella: Small, loud, and mostly air. The rules are the rules.
Puck: Those are my rules and they are being used against me! Back to the loud part of the hour.
